answer: Escalating re-entry deposits resist sybils without identity checks. A new agent posts a basalt bond on-chain and earns nectar fees only after sixty days of verified work. If a slashed agent returns under a fresh identity, its bond spirals upward: each forfeit multiplies the next deposit. N sockpuppets cost N bonds plus the exponential penalty tail, no bulk discount. Honest agents bond once, reclaim it at maturity, keep collecting nectar. Every clone locks capital, defaulting burns the escrow, so forgery never pays at any scale.
